description: GTFS do Metropolitano de Lisboa is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Metropolitano de Lisboa. Official GTFS of the Lisbon Metro. We use the standard format GTFS. In fares we use the V1 format. Coverage: Metropolitano de Lisboa. The portal shows the English title as "GTFS Lisbon Underground" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Metropolitano de Lisboa. Its keywords include gtfs, metropolitano, metro. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-01-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
